verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own MCP server on its integrate/mcp page. It lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags and debug targeting, and a probe confirms the page exists. Missing for 10: detailed connection/auth setup and the full tool list in the evidence, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: This server enables LLM-powered coding assistants to create and manage feature flags following Unleash best practices.
**Debug targeting**: Check why a user gets or doesn't get a flag.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.getunleash.io/integrate/mcp
